data.label: exclude
data.reason_zh: 反馈仅用于当前游戏工件的有限修复，通过门禁后发布；未显示修改可复用工件或用于后续任务。

scope_support.exclusion_quote: Each blocker returns to the agent that owns the affected artifact for a bounded repair, and the game is released once all the gates pass.
scope_support.feedback_quote: Build-linked real-UI checks and a code-blind critic then verify that build and decide whether the game may ship.
